historical_corpus_inventory.counting_rule: family classifications below are exclusive; endpoint labels are bounded, not full-domain or physical qualification

gaps.missing_contract: TCLab relative seconds are explicit; CO2 calendar indices are not sensor ticks. ClockSync/acquired-window needs acquisition identities, tick/host matching, clock model and joint time covariance. No independent multi-clock offset/skew truth is held.

CAREX A,B,Q,R are Riccati control matrices, not automatically observation H, process Q and measurement R for an estimator. Nile/CO2/TCLab supply observations but no agreed prior, observation model, dynamics, noise covariance or independent state truth.

NIST groups and empirical graph edges do not define affine conservation constraints or joint covariance. SBML case3 provides weighted conservation but needs explicit species-amount state mapping and discrepancy/covariance policy for reconciliation, distinct from parent trajectory verification.

SIDT fits fully observed discrete LTI state/input sequences with sample alignment and held-out metadata. CAREX matrices are continuous or generalized algebraic benchmarks; TCLab temperatures/heater-percent columns are not a declaration that measured outputs are the complete state. Misra1a is static nonlinear regression.

Full UCI profile labels are held, so labelled fault data is available. Native fdir.evaluate_residual/assess_isolability still requires a declared residual map, covariance, fault-signature dictionary and thresholds. The existing API cannot consume raw labelled UCI channels as a trained classifier; the mapping/model decision remains open.

Native identified-stability requires retained discrete identified point model, explicit sample period, selected state and caller-supplied sealed quadratic P. CAREX continuous matrices and cost weights do not supply that contract; a Riccati solution is not automatically the required certificate. Generalized DARE also includes nonidentity E.

CGGT requires two SPD matrices of 1..8 named coordinates, frame/units, affine-invariant metric and geodesic parameters. CAREX Q/R are cost weights, not two identified covariances; geographic distances and pairwise spatial metrics are not SPD-manifold references. Backstep turbulent moments could form a covariance only after scaling/sign conventions and omitted cross-moments are resolved; unavailable moments cannot be zero-filled.

IAPWS IF97 Region1/4 coefficients and reference states are complete enough for their equations, but no existing IF97 consumer appears in src/ciw or consolidated instruments. The dry ideal-gas atmosphere and ET0 vapour relation are different equations. Calling SciPy/reference corpus kernels would not execute a NET consumer.

DMTA temperature/frequency/Eprime/Edoubleprime sweeps are not molding-cycle channels. Existing cycle assessment expects process/material identity, sensors in specified units, sample times and process model. Sultanova n(lambda) and dispersion formulas are optical properties; no Sellmeier evaluator was identified in native NET code.

SKZ summary gives repeat-run/material/tool identities and aggregate energy, but not native time-indexed cavity pressure/temperature channels, traceable sensor policies, complete acceptance envelopes or part-quality labels.

OR-Library provides integer operation duration, machine ordering, complete ft06/ft10/ft20/la01 jobs. NET production APIs orchestrate authorised worker/capability/check graphs and do not optimize disjunctive machine schedules or accept OR-Library duration matrices. Job-shop integer time has no supplied seconds conversion.

TCLab seconds/degC and percent heater command are supplied; percent is not power. Thermal model requires heat capacity/conductance/input watts, sensor/clock/covariance and boundary declarations. DMTA modulus and IAPWS water state equations are not those thermal dynamics.

Existing reservoir and shallow-water profiles require their own dimensions, forcing and BCs. Annual Nile volume is not local velocity/pressure. Driver-Seegmiller turbulent backstep data has flow geometry/reference conventions but NET has no matching RANS/turbulence solver; neither reservoir nor 1D wave model reproduces it. IF97 is not implemented.

Compiler expects prescribed dry temperature/wind vs height, surface pressure/gravity and fixed coefficients. CO2/ElNino/sunspots are temporal series, not complete hydrostatic columns. IF97 liquid/saturated water does not match fixed dry-gas physics.
CAREX and special-function arrays have no mass, effective spring stiffness, initial contact state, plate geometry/material parameters or impact-force histories matching native profiles.

GeographicLib table gives latitude/longitude/azimuth/distance on WGS84 ellipsoid, including unrolled longitude. Existing GSC endpoint projects timed lon/lat/ellipsoidal-height samples into local ENU and needs origin, height and recording time. Flat-torus/constant-curvature geodesic providers do not solve WGS84 inverse geodesics.

Middlebury/image/digit arrays are usable data but not scene/asset capture requests. Optical n,k tables do not specify scene geometry, light spectrum, camera response or rendering conventions. No matching stereo/classifier numerical consumer identified in NET.
JSON Schema meta-schemas and spatial arrays contain no IFC entity/relationship graph, units, chosen quantities, edits or native CSE mapping witness.

Ed25519 vectors sign arbitrary source bytes, while NET legibility verifies a domain-separated complete bundle message. Raw vectors cannot be directly passed as bundle signatures. JCS numbers follow RFC8785; native NET deliberately uses its different sort-keys/ASCII/Python-binary64 profile. RDF canonicalization fixtures are now held but native legibility is neither RDF canonicalization nor JCS; select the exact external profile separately without replacing NET identities.

Job-shop integer times are not token budgets, observed yields or GPU power/runtime records. CAREX/special-function arrays can serve as workload inputs only after exact kernel and independent expected accuracy are defined.

UCI now supplies actual hydraulic condition labels and channel observations. hardware.assess still requires explicit device/configuration identity, a compatible declared test plan and supported acceptance policies; its contracts do not automatically derive those from the UCI labels. Binary files/digits remain only auxiliary fixtures.

Empirical graphs/schemas/molecules are documents/objects, but do not supply native schematic coordinates/declarations or query-to-relevance/claim judgments. Native schematics dispatches declared eligible tools; it is not a BEIR ranking endpoint.
Generic JSON schemas and signature vectors do not encode actual NET command requests, capabilities, authorization boundaries, expected refusals or cancellation/replay outcomes.
No source in this family is acquired. Native perspective module is an explicitly authored qualitative contract and does not infer historical truth.

Resonance/special-function values are not the native linear bead-spring HOOMD model parameters/GSD trajectories. They also do not provide neutrino event-generator/cross-section validation for GENIE, whose matching NET endpoint was not identified.

Johnson-Christy n,k and Sultanova dispersion fits supply wavelength-dependent optical parameters and bounded formula definitions. They do not supply a NET optical/Maxwell consumer; no Fresnel/Sellmeier/IF97-like generic evaluator was located. Special-function kernel fixtures alone are not wave-field inputs.
Digits/Norris supply labels/numerical response but not monotonicity domains, shape constraints, lattice structure or an installed native constrained learner contract.

Copper historical econometric table has year/variable definitions, not a native current-price/forecast model. CSV observation route demands physical clock seconds, so year indexing must not be silently converted to a fabricated acquisition timeline.
